title: Original 2D
note: Everything drawn by code (Canvas 2D): buildings, people, horse, fields, sky.

title: Sprite art support
note: Buildings can come from picture files, the code drawing as fallback; lit windows at night. Looks like the original until art exists.

title: Blender farm (2D)
note: The farm built as a 3D model and rendered by Blender into game pictures (the 10 m farm).

title: Real-time 3D prototype
note: The farm drawn live in 3D through the game's camera; sides show as you ride past; the sun moves, shadows fade at sunset.

title: Game builds the farm
note: The 3D farm generated in the game, about 9 meshes, every farm a little different; no model file.

title: 2D · 3D switch, merged
note: Merged with the cell-grid game; a 2D · 3D button by the zoom keys (or V).

title: Farm fits its plot
note: The farm lower and wider on its 6 × 3 plot; 2D mode shows the Blender farm.

title: One drawing camera
note: The picture drawn through a camera further back (the camera slider): depth no longer stretched.

title: Camera height
note: A camera height slider: a more top-down view, the road wider, the horizon higher.

title: Faster at 4K
note: Hidden fills of the hills removed: about 41 to 70 fps at 3840×2160.

title: Other streets' farms in 3D
note: Farms on other streets drawn in 3D at their true place, facing their own street.

title: Crops on other streets
note: Other streets' fields grow real crops; their 3D buildings sort by distance (a well behind a farm is hidden).

title: Near buildings sort right
note: A building between camera and road covers the rider correctly; near crops capped in size.
